text:
```yaml
name: Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Free Pascal Compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fpc

      - name: Build Tests
        run: |
          cd tests
          fpc -O3 -Fu../neural RunTests.lpr

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          cd tests
          ./RunTests
```
